title: Tissaphernes
summary: Raleigh names Tissaphernes in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Tissaphernes, Lieutenant of the Persian King, whom Alcibiades bewitched, and who made the supplies promised to the Peloponnesians vnprofitable. The printed spelling is kept. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book III, Part I, Chapter VIII, §. IX, sig. 431b–432a
